Type: table
Name: Strathwood Whidbey Cast-Aluminum Rectangular Dining Table
Materials: cast aluminum
Rectangular 6-person dining table with 2-inch umbrella hole in the center Made of durable yet lightweight, rust-resistant cast aluminum Elegant multi-step hand finish and scrolling lattice motif design on top Some assembly required; coordinates with Whidbey collection (sold separately) Measures 72 inches long by 43 inches wide by 28 inches high Rust Free Cast Aluminum Frame Elegant Multi-Step Hand Finish Sturdy Construction
